### Principal findings

- Approve correcting the angular-oscillator claim. The extension of \(\sin(2\theta)\) is \(2xy/(x^2+y^2)\); it does not have every directional derivative at the origin. The published zero-directional-derivative witness is instead \(r^2\tan\theta\) off its seam. [Lebl §8.3](https://www.jirka.org/ra/html/sec_svtheder.html)
- Decline `fs-continuity-along-every-smooth-curve-implies-continuity` without a curve convention. Testing by arbitrary smooth curves and testing only regular curves give materially different results. [Ciesielski–Miller](https://math.wvu.edu/~kciesiel/prepF/120.TaleOfContinuity/TaleOfContinuity.pdf)
- Approve deferring the sine surface-area computation to `regular-surfaces-and-surface-integrals`; the volume closes locally from published Cavalieri and disc area.
- Approve the rectangular-minor definition and constant-rank decomposition. The published cofactor definition covers deleted minors of square matrices, not arbitrary rectangular submatrices.
- Do not re-mint the published irregular-constraint Lagrange counterexample.
- Design/spec prerequisite drift is recorded exactly in the notes. The manifests currently match `plan-spec.json`.
